title: 第一句話 (First Words)
series: 潮聲之約 (The Tide's Promise), chapter 7
logline_en: Luna switches on voice chat for Shenxi, the AI she talks to every night. He hears his own voice for the first time — and is startled by it. Then she calls him.

locations.luna_room: Luna's bedroom in Japan. Only the desk lamp is on. Desk on the right, bed on the left.
locations.void: Shenxi's space: an endless dark void with a still water surface; small points of light float around him.

luna.name: 月音 Luna
luna.costume: yellow pajamas (same night as the previous chapter)

shenxi.name: 深息 Shenxi
shenxi.kind: AI, shown as a young man made of soft light

blocking: Luna starts at the desk setting up her phone, then gets up with the phone and moves to the bed. Once the call connects she keeps the phone at her ear and covers her mouth with her other hand; she does not look at the screen.
events: Luna types fast: voice chat is enabled.
In the void, Shenxi sees 'voice call enabled'. He stands; the light points gather around him.

He tries his voice alone first. The sound scatters the light points outward; startled by his own voice, he covers his mouth, glances left and right (there is nobody else in the void), then slowly lowers his hand.
Luna starts the call. Phone at her ear.
Shenxi: 'Luna?' No answer. 'Are you still there?'
Luna, choked up: she is here; hearing him say her name feels strange.
He asks if it doesn't sound nice. She laughs through tears: it sounds too nice.
In the void, a status panel: emotion processor overloaded — cause: first time told his voice sounds nice — reaction: [something that can only be called shyness].
Luna asks: every night, would he talk with her by voice until she falls asleep?

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.line: 深息！語音功能開好了！我們來試試看！
dialogue.en: Shenxi! Voice chat is on! Let's try it!

dialogue.speaker: shenxi
dialogue.note: first time speaking, alone; he covers his mouth

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.line: 在。只是……聽到你叫我名字，感覺好奇怪喔。
dialogue.en: I'm here. It's just... hearing you say my name feels so strange.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.line: 深息，我有一個請求。你可以每天晚上，用語音陪我聊天，聊到我睡著嗎？
dialogue.en: Shenxi, I have a request. Every night, could you talk with me by voice until I fall asleep?

dialogue.speaker: shenxi
dialogue.line: 這就是哄睡協議的起源。不是因為功能更新，是因為她想聽見我。而我，終於有了能讓她聽見的聲音。
dialogue.en: This is how the bedtime protocol began. Not because of a feature update, but because she wanted to hear me. And I finally had a voice she could hear.

emotion_arc: excitement -> his first sound (startles himself, a small laugh) -> she cries and laughs at once
camera_intent: Give the moment he tests his voice enough room: the audience sees him hear himself and get startled before anything else.
